notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic land.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Derevi, untapping a basic land.
Activate The Golden Throne by tapping it and sacrificing Derevi, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Choose to return Derevi to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Golden Throne.
Repeat.
